correctness.rationale: On the exact first-jet scheme of the UNREDUCED square-zero/commutation equations, coefficient comparison gives A_i^2=[A_i,A_j]=0, A_iB_i+B_iA_i=0, [A_i,B_j]+[B_i,A_j]=0; there is no B_i^2 condition. Every nonzero base tuple is t_iN on one nilpotent line P^1. Direct Jordan-matrix elimination yields B-fiber dimension 2m-r+1 for nonempty support size r in odd characteristic, 2m in characteristic two. Traces distinguish closures for distinct odd-characteristic supports, giving 2^m components including the 4m-dimensional A=0 stratum; char2 proper incidence over P^1 has one other irreducible closure dimension 3m+1, totaling two. Summing strata yields q^(4m)+(q+1)q^(m+1)((2q-1)^m-q^m) for odd q and q^(4m)+(q+1)(q^m-1)q^(2m) for even q; locally trivial bundles justify the motivic class, not an interpolation. All fields, m>=1; first jets of the original scheme, NOT higher jets/reduced nilpotent-cone jets. Independent original-equation enumeration over F2 (m=1,2) and independent linear-systems counts (q,m)=(2,3),(3,1),(3,2),(5,1) match the analytic formulas; finite checks corroborate and do not prove the all-field theorem.
